title: Death Swap
description: This is a datapack the makes you play Death swap like dream and baablu
body:
🔁 DeathSwap — Multiplayer Minigame Datapack
DeathSwap is an intense multiplayer survival minigame where players are randomly swapped every few minutes.
Use strategy, traps, and quick thinking to eliminate your friends while surviving the swaps.

Players are randomly spread when the game starts, receive a permanent water bucket, and fight until only one player remains.

Supports 2–6 players with configurable swap time and death limit.

Last player alive wins.

⭐ Features
✅ Random player spread (within 500 blocks)
✅ Manual swap command
✅ Death counter + spectator elimination
✅ Configurable swap interval & max deaths
✅ Permanent water bucket
✅ Optional inventory wipe start
✅ Works with mods

 

▶ How To Start (Quick Guide)
Put the datapack in your world folder:

/saves/<world>/datapacks
 
 
2.In-game run:

/reload
 
 
3.Start the game:

/function start
 
 
Commands
 
Set swap time (seconds)
/trigger ds_interval set <seconds>
 
Example:

/trigger ds_interval set 180
 
 
Set max deaths before spectator
/trigger ds_maxdeaths set <number>
 
Example:
/trigger ds_maxdeaths set 5
 
 
Start game
 
/function start
 
 
Start + clear inventory

/function clear_start

 

Force instant swap

/function swap

 

Stop game

/function stop
